judge.best_line: Oh wonderful, he's yelling in my living room now. Gary is not in here, SpongeBob, have you tried being loud, somewhere else?
judge.worst_line: SpongeBob! Hey! Nothing over there, nothing at all! Get back here this instant!
judge.comment: Protective deflection makes the book irresistible without ever feeling like a quest marker.
